name: solarpunk
description: Create, explore, critique, and practice solarpunk across visual art and image prompts, fiction and worldbuilding, fashion, games, education, everyday living, adaptive reuse, ecological design, parklets, guerrilla gardening, urban and rural planning, community infrastructure, and hopeful collective futures. Use for solarpunk aesthetics, stories, values, or practical paths toward equitable ecological flourishing.
